lines.text: Upround's keys got you into the convention center. The world's last hackathon is still going. Three thousand people, all building the same chatbot wrapper.
lines.spoken: Upround's keys got you into the convention center. The world's last hackathon is still going. Three thousand people, all building the same chatbot wrapper.

lines.text: Attention, hackers. A disgruntled former user is in the building. Whoever stops them wins a term sheet and a one-way ticket off the waitlist.
lines.spoken: Attention, hackers. A disgruntled former user is in the building. Whoever stops them wins a term sheet, and a one way ticket off the waitlist.

lines.text: Overclass's campus shuttle leaves from the back hall, but security locked every door. I'm cracking the lock. It'll take a minute. Until then, survive.
lines.spoken: Overclass's campus shuttle leaves from the back hall, but security locked every door. I'm cracking the lock. It'll take a minute. Until then, survive.

lines.text: And grab first prize off the stage: a valuation bubble gun. Press 6. Whatever it hits, it inflates, and then it pops.
